zh.title: 新功能
items: **本地运行时能力进一步模块化**：新增可复用的 Runtime SDK、Node 宿主适配器与受治理的运行管线，为后续接入更多本地能力和宿主形态打下基础。
**计划创建后提供下一步操作**：Goal 模式生成计划后会展示可继续执行的操作入口，减少计划与执行之间的中断。
**上下文压缩过程可追踪**：消息轨道新增压缩节点，便于识别自动压缩发生的位置和执行状态。

zh.title: 优化
items: **自动压缩生命周期更稳定**：统一压缩进度、完成事件和上下文统计更新链路，压缩完成后能够及时刷新界面状态。
**当前问题导航更可靠**：优化长对话滚动时当前问题条的状态处理，减少切换和流式输出期间的显示抖动。

zh.title: 修复
items: 修复自动压缩提醒可能在处理中途提前消失的问题。
修复自动压缩完成后底部上下文数字未同步更新的问题。
修复当前问题条在部分滚动与流式更新场景下状态不稳定的问题。

en.title: What's New
items: **More modular local runtime**: Reusable Runtime SDK, Node host adapter, and governed run pipeline for more local capabilities and host shapes later.
**Next actions after plan creation**: Goal mode shows continue-run entry points after generating a plan so plan→execute is less interrupted.
**Trackable context compaction**: Message rail adds compact nodes so you can see where auto-compact happened and its status.

en.title: Improvements
items: **More stable auto-compact lifecycle**: Unified progress, completion events, and context stats so the UI refreshes promptly after compact.
**More reliable current-question nav**: Better state handling while scrolling long chats and during streaming.

en.title: Fixes
items: Fixed auto-compact notices disappearing too early mid-process.
Fixed bottom context numbers not updating after auto-compact finished.
Fixed current-question bar instability in some scroll/stream update cases.
